summary: Vireo Growth Inc. (Parent) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement with Planet 13 Holdings Inc. (Company) and Supernova Merger Sub Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Vireo. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge with and into Planet 13, with Planet 13 surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Vireo. Each outstanding share of Planet 13 common stock (excluding canceled and dissenting shares) will be converted into the right to receive 0.015383618 subordinate voting shares of Vireo (the Exchange Ratio). Both boards approved the transaction; Planet 13's board acted on a unanimous recommendation of its special committee of independent directors. The filing does not disclose financial terms, premium, or expected closing date. The merger consideration is all-stock. Watch for stockholder votes, regulatory approvals, and potential dissenting shareholder actions; the risk-arb spread depends on relative share prices of the two companies.
